svg.title: FairMate production architecture
svg.desc: Browser moves enter a capability-protected referee, which enforces chess.js legality and the five minute clock, calls qwen3.7-max through the 0G Router verified TeeTLS boundary, commits SAN, FEN and receipt hashes to MoveJournal on Aristotle Mainnet, and settles the journal-bound ChallengePot: 0.1 OG stake to enter, 0.2 OG paid on a recorded win, draws and aborts auto-refund. An offline verifier recomputes exported evidence against public chain state, 604 of 604 checks pass.
svg.text: events · pot binding · public chain state
ai clock burns on inference · chain confirmations never block play · docs/THREAT-MODEL.md maps every money path
